name: Pickerel Lake Recreation Area (West Campground)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery at 220 m half-width (0.49 m/px) and a 110 m half-width frame (0.24 m/px) over the lake-side north rows, every Go Outdoors SD facID=47 loop 83 (West Campground) unit point plotted; both frames rendered. North rows 27E/29E/31E/33E/34E/36E: back-in pads whose ends sit ~11-20 m from the canopy edge over Pickerel Lake, with a continuous belt of shore trees between pads and water along the whole north shore (grass under the trees, but no open unused apron to the water); the modern cabin and cabins C3/C4 are not RV sites. The rest of the loop (1E-26E, 37E, 38E, 41E) is inland of these rows. No RV pad has open ground to the water, so not lakefront; the lake is in filtered view from the north rows -> lakeview (stored value kept, evidence re-measured for the West Campground alone after the East Campground split). Natural glacial lake, no dam.
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=47 ('Pickerel Lake Recreation Area'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, loop 83 (the West Campground): 34 web-bookable electric RV sites 1E-41E (no 4E, 15E, 21E-23E, 39E or 40E), back-ins plus pull-thrus 16E, 20E and 35E, 'Amp Service: 50', MaxEquipLength 45-135 ft, UnitBasePrice $30; camping cabins C1-C4 ($60), modern cabin MC ($150), group shelter PS; host V1 not sold online. GFP West Campground map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/pickerel_w_cg.pdf (ArcGIS Pro, modified 2024-06-28): the same numbering on the north shore, with restroom/shower, vault toilet, water hydrants, playground, dump station, swim beach, boat ramp and an entrance booth on its own road from 446th Ave. Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel pads at the unit points on a branching loop. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 45 ft, 25E and 33E). The East Campground (loop 82), 2.43 km away RV-site centroid to centroid with its own entrance off Hwy 6, was split out 2026-11-22. Public (state): no price gate.
note: Pickerel Lake Recreation Area's West Campground, on the wooded north shore of Pickerel Lake 10 mi N of Waubay off US-12, with its own entrance road, swim beach, boat ramp, camping cabins and a modern cabin. The East Campground, about 2.4 km away on the east shore with its own entrance, is a separate entry. North-row sites 27E-36E look at the lake through a belt of shore trees. 2026 reviews on the booking site warn of branches overhanging the roads and sites that can scrape rooftop units. --Claude

sites.note: Plus camping cabins C1-C4, a modern cabin and a group picnic shelter.

sites.source: https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=47 sitesHashMap, loop 83 (West Campground), read 2026-11-22: 34 web-bookable RV sites 1E-41E (4E, 15E, 21E-23E, 39E, 40E absent); 'Pull-Thru Campsite' 16E (115 ft), 20E (135 ft), 35E (90 ft), the rest 'Back-In Campsite'; MaxEquipLength 45-135 ft; host V1 ('Host Site', not ReservableOnline) excluded; cabins C1-C4, modern cabin MC, group shelter PS.
